NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development. Nothing is open or for sale, and no site has been chosen. Pictures are concept visualizations or drawings, not photographs of NASHA.

Name, images and allergens

The name was chosen by the founder; legal clearance is pending and nothing here claims trademark ownership. The word NASHA in the header and in some pictures is a temporary typographic placeholder, not a logo. Nasha means intoxication or addiction in Hindi and Urdu: we chose it for the feeling of being drawn in by food, craft and company, we will never present excess as something to admire, and cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Photographic-style pictures are concept visualizations made with AI tools and edited; drawings are illustrations. None is a photograph of NASHA, its food or its beer (about these images). Dishes are designs for testing, not served food; heat and vegetarian labels are design intent, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly; alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.
